skilllearnbench.method_scope_note: human_written omitted by author decision (2026-10-26); direct_oracle is the rubric-free ablation sharing the SkillLift arm, seeds, executor, instance-1 training and held-out roster
skilllearnbench.claim: held-out instances within seen task families
skilllearnbench.human_written_label: author-provided reference skills; train-only authorship not established
skilllearnbench.harness: shared OpenAI-compatible Docker tool agent with official environments and verifiers; not the original Claude CLI harness

skillopt.selection_protocol: fresh executions of instance 1; no held-out selection instances

direct_oracle.rounds_and_candidates: same max_rounds and max_candidates_per_round as skilllift; one oracle execution per valid candidate; at most 1 + max_rounds * max_candidates_per_round rollouts per cell before infrastructure retries
direct_oracle.acceptance: oracle reward improves; on equal reward, a higher oracle criterion pass fraction (replaces the SkillLift verifier tie-break)
direct_oracle.stopping: same as the SkillLift coordinator: anchor_terminal, terminal_candidate, two_no_improvement_rounds, round_budget_exhausted, all_candidates_invalid
direct_oracle.infrastructure_retries: same candidate retried up to the SkillLift max_consecutive_infra_failures (default 3); an infrastructure failure is never a score

ablation.note: Native SkillsBench/WildClaw ablation dropped on 2026-10-26. The Direct Oracle ablation runs inside the SkillLearnBench generalization command as method direct_oracle.

statistics.incomplete_cohorts: report coverage only; do not calculate CI or p

notes: 1 evolution_run by author decision (2026-10-26, time); this protocol does not estimate run-to-run variability. An evolution run is a fresh optimization process, not a retry.
The 2 internal SkillLift final trials are training-instance reevaluations, not held-out tests.
No skill, human-written and frozen LLM-written repeat execution once per run index; they are not re-authored.
Completed family/run cells resume by frozen content hash. Interrupted training cells restart in a new attempt.
Two days is a runtime target, not a measured guarantee. Review pilot costs and timing before the full run.
